Title: The future of the Secret Library?

Messages.Author: jaakkon
Messages.Body:
What is the news of the future of secretlibrary.info at the moment?
This is a bit of a follow-up to  this turn the conversation took in an another thread .

Outside Facebook, I've only seen quotations of Jussi Hattara's announcement that he's letting go of the project and the site.
Also, the new cards released in the bundles can't be found in the database.
Has somebody been able to contact Jussi about the continuation of the site?
I've heard that the site would keep running at least until February, are there any other news on that?

I have been using the site for soon to be six years, and I've seen it has been very useful to a good part of our player community.
If we can't find new owners I would love to have suggestions for the best alternative  for keeping track of my collection for keeping track of my deck lists (there are too many) preferably with a way to import the data as exported from Secret Library
Also if somebody needs help running and maintaining Secret Library, I wonder if there is something I could do to help?

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
I reached out and asked about the possibility of a data export.

But there are issues around privacy; for example all decks are associated with an account / email address. Without that username / email address it's not possible to link the decks etc to a user — without that users permission it's not appropriate to share their address or data.

So your best bet to at least secure the data while the site is still up is to request it as per the below:

> You can make a request for your data through this page or by directly contacting the admin Jussi Hattara. Data, including decks and inventories, will be delivered in human readable CSV format to the email address specified in the user account.
>
Amaranth Deck Building Tool :  VTES NZ :  VTES ANZ Facebook
